title: Fallow Theatre | Technical rehearsal handover
titleZh: 法洛劇院｜技術彩排交接
passage:
Read these notes before tomorrow's technical run. A break ends as soon as the next scene can begin. If one job is already holding up the next scene, finishing another job during that same interval does not make the audience wait longer. For caller handovers, a 'stand by' message prepares the crew and 'go' tells them to act. If a caller is interrupted, the replacement resumes with the earliest cue that was actually started but has not yet reached its stated endpoint. Use the endpoint on the current cue sheet, not an old mark left on the stage. A movement in progress does not count as finished.

After Scene 2, the platform takes three minutes to put in place. Attaching the street sign then takes one more minute; the next scene cannot begin until both are ready. Folding the market banner takes two minutes, entirely within the platform's three minutes. The sign crew has tested putting a clip-on sign on the platform as it is moved, so the sign will need no work afterward. The stage manager also suggests folding the banner faster. Compared with the current setup, the clip-on sign will [143] _____.

The caller said 'go' for Cue 21, and the window panel reached the square shown on the current sheet as its endpoint. She said 'go' for Cue 22. The crew stopped the bench at the triangle, where the previous rehearsal ended that movement. Today’s sheet shows the back wall as its endpoint, and the bench is not there. She had already issued a 'stand by' for Cue 23 before she lost her connection. The spare caller’s sheet therefore shows marks beside all three cues. The spare caller should [144] _____.

For the opening, the actors are recording two versions of the welcoming lines: one for audiences who have already been welcomed by the host, and one for audiences who have heard nothing yet. The second version includes separate directions for finding the side aisles; the host has already given those directions to the audience who hears the first version. The director says, 'Slow down when you read the aisle directions, but keep the pace of the greeting as it is.' In other words, the note [145] _____.

A local composer offered to join the technical run. We value her ear for transitions, but there is no reason to keep her in the theatre through the equipment checks. There will be a separate short run of the scene changes at the end. The stage runner wrote to her, 'It would be useful if you were around for the scene changes, but we don’t need you on call.' In other words, the invitation [146] _____.
passageZh:
明天技術彩排前，請先閱讀這些備忘。下一幕一能開始，換景空檔就結束。如果有一項工作已經在拖住下一幕，另一項在同一段時間內做完的工作，不會讓觀眾多等。交接叫 cue 工作時，「預備」是請組員準備，「開始」才是請他們執行。如果原叫 cue 人員中斷，接手者要從已經開始、卻尚未到達指定終點的最早一個 cue 接續。請以本版提示單上的終點為準，不要沿用留在舞臺上的舊標記。正在移動並不算完成。

第二幕結束後，臺座要花三分鐘才能就位，之後再花一分鐘掛上街道標牌。這兩項都準備好，下一幕才能開始。收折市集布旗需要兩分鐘，全程都在臺座就位的三分鐘內完成。標牌組已測試在移動臺座時同步裝上夾式標牌，因此事後不必再處理標牌。舞臺監督也建議加快收折布旗。和目前的配置相比，夾式標牌會[143] _____。

叫 cue 的人對第 21 號 cue 發出「開始」，窗板也移到本版提示單指定為終點的方形標記。她接著對第 22 號 cue 發出「開始」。組員把長凳停在三角標記處，也就是上次彩排中這個動作的終點。但今天的提示單把後牆列為終點，長凳並不在後牆。連線中斷前，她已對第 23 號 cue 發出「預備」。因此備援人員的提示單上，三個 cue 旁都有記號。備援人員應[144] _____。

開場時，演員將錄製兩個版本的歡迎詞。一版給已聽過主持人歡迎的觀眾，另一版給還沒聽到任何內容的觀眾。第二版另外附有如何找到兩側走道的引導說明；聽第一版的觀眾已從主持人口中聽過這段說明。導演說：「念到走道的引導說明時放慢速度，歡迎詞的步調則維持不變。」換句話說，這則備註[145] _____。

一位本地作曲家表示可以來參加技術彩排。我們看重她對過場銜接的敏銳度，但沒必要請她留在劇院等設備檢查結束。最後會另外短暫排練換景。舞臺助理寫信告訴她：「如果換景時您有空到場，會很有幫助，但不需要您隨時待命。」換句話說，這份邀請[146] _____。

If one job is already holding up the next scene, finishing another job during that same interval does not make the audience wait longer. For caller handovers, a 'stand by' message prepares the crew and 'go' tells them to act. If a caller is interrupted, the replacement resumes with the earliest cue that was actually started but has not yet reached its stated endpoint. Use the endpoint on the current cue sheet, not an old mark left on the stage. A movement in progress does not count as finished.

After Scene 2, the platform takes three minutes to put in place. Attaching the street sign then takes one more minute; the next scene cannot begin until both are ready. Folding the market banner takes two minutes, entirely within the platform's three minutes. The sign crew has tested putting a clip-on sign on the platform as it is moved, so the sign will need no work afterward. The stage manager also suggests folding the banner faster. Compared with the current setup, the clip-on sign will shorten the break by one minute, even if the banner is folded at the usual speed.

The caller said 'go' for Cue 21, and the window panel reached the square shown on the current sheet as its endpoint. She said 'go' for Cue 22. The crew stopped the bench at the triangle, where the previous rehearsal ended that movement. Today’s sheet shows the back wall as its endpoint, and the bench is not there. She had already issued a 'stand by' for Cue 23 before she lost her connection. The spare caller’s sheet therefore shows marks beside all three cues. The spare caller should resume at Cue 22 because the bench movement still has to reach its endpoint.

For the opening, the actors are recording two versions of the welcoming lines: one for audiences who have already been welcomed by the host, and one for audiences who have heard nothing yet. The second version includes separate directions for finding the side aisles; the host has already given those directions to the audience who hears the first version. The director says, 'Slow down when you read the aisle directions, but keep the pace of the greeting as it is.' In other words, the note changes the pace of the directions only in the recording for audiences who have not heard the host.

A local composer offered to join the technical run. We value her ear for transitions, but there is no reason to keep her in the theatre through the equipment checks. There will be a separate short run of the scene changes at the end. The stage runner wrote to her, 'It would be useful if you were around for the scene changes, but we don’t need you on call.' In other words, the invitation welcomes her input at the shorter run without asking her to remain available throughout.
